rows.original_synopsis_draft: Spock and McCoy are compelled to take part in violent games resembling ancient Roman contests.
An encounter leaves Spock, Sulu and Uhura at the mercy of captors.
Spock revisits his own childhood to prevent a fatal event in his younger life.
McCoy is accused of having caused a devastating illness on an alien world.
The Enterprise crew undergoes scrutiny to determine its suitability for contact with advanced civilizations.
The Enterprise investigates an apparently abandoned spacecraft orbiting a lifeless star.

rows.official_title: How Sharper Than a Serpent's Tooth
rows.original_synopsis_draft: The crew encounters a being with a surprising historical connection to Maya civilization on Earth.
Exploring the planet Argo results in an unexpected transformation of Kirk and Spock.
Harry Mudd resurfaces to sell a supposed love potion that does not work as advertised.
The crew returns to an amusement-park world after its caretaker dies, finding the computer in control.

rows.official_title: One of Our Planets is Missing
rows.original_synopsis_draft: A mysterious and destructive cloud presents a threat to populated planets.
Telepathic aliens confine Kirk, Spock and McCoy inside an unfamiliar zoological collection.
A scientist's experiments have produced a species of intelligent plant life.
Kirk leads an expedition seeking to recover an object of religious importance after it is stolen.
A group of women preserves its longevity by draining vital energy from men.
Near the center of the galaxy, the Enterprise meets beings with remarkable powers.
